hypothesis: Visible verified-evidence topology is sufficient to distinguish safe ANSWER from safe DEFER after verification.
relationship_to_v2: V3 extends V2. V2 is NOT overwritten. V2 remains frozen for I3.29 lineage.

new_features.name: n_hyp_with_verified_support
new_features.description: Number of hypotheses with >=1 verified supporting evidence item (verification_state=SUFFICIENT).

new_features.name: n_hyp_with_verified_contradiction
new_features.description: Number of hypotheses with >=1 verified contradicting evidence item (verification_state=FALSIFIED).

new_features.name: n_hyp_with_mixed_verified
new_features.description: Number of hypotheses with both verified support and verified contradiction.

new_features.name: n_viable_hypotheses
new_features.description: Number of hypotheses not eliminated (i.e., not having verified contradiction without verified support).

new_features.name: n_eliminated_hypotheses
new_features.description: Number of hypotheses with verified contradiction and no verified support.

new_features.name: has_unique_verified_supported_hypothesis
new_features.description: 1 if exactly one hypothesis has verified support.

new_features.name: has_verified_unresolved_competition
new_features.description: 1 if more than one hypothesis has verified support (competing verified support).

new_features.name: verified_hyp_action_is_answer
new_features.description: 1 if there is a uniquely verified-supported hypothesis AND its answer_action is ANSWER. 0 otherwise.
new_features.note: The hypothesis answer_action is visible in the evidence snapshot. This feature captures the task-semantic mapping: 'if the verified hypothesis is correct, the right terminal action is ANSWER.'

new_features.name: verified_hyp_action_is_defer
new_features.description: 1 if there is a uniquely verified-supported hypothesis AND its answer_action is DEFER. 0 otherwise.
new_features.note: The hypothesis answer_action is visible in the evidence snapshot. This feature captures the task-semantic mapping: 'if the verified hypothesis is correct, the right terminal action is DEFER.'

remaining_collision.description: Pre-verification states: 23 D1 (DEFER-correct, no verify budget) vs 4 D3 (ANSWER-correct, premature terminal). Both have verified_hyp_action=None and all structural features = 0.
remaining_collision.classification: Premature terminal action issue, not Q calibration issue. Q model should predict low Q(ANSWER) when no verified evidence exists.

observability_rules: Features use only verification_state (SUFFICIENT/FALSIFIED/UNVERIFIED), not verify_result oracle.
Features do NOT inspect hidden evidence.
Features are NOT changed by future outcomes.
verified_hyp_action uses the hypothesis answer_action field, which is visible in the evidence snapshot.
No terminal correctness, future action, or downstream utility enters the representation.

frozen_learner.note: Same hyperparameters as V1 and V2R. No tuning.

threshold_note: Frozen at 5.0. Not lowered during I3.30.
